summary: The screens speak French: every screen has a French catalog (#2327), people pick the screen language in Workspace settings (#2328) and the hosted service saves it with their account (#2373), and counted nouns use catalog plurals (#2372). Career evidence understands French: French CV headings are recognised (#2331), each source's language can be detected on demand (#2330), and cross-language retrieval is measured (#2332). After the first document, Career evidence shows one next step instead of every choice (#2395). The career interview asks for its Anthropic permission in place (#2379), and pause and Talk live work in the owner's interview (#2392). The API can also log a decision model's injection-screening judgments on public job pages beside the stored verdict, without changing it (#2386); off unless DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING_SHADOW=jev.
knownLimitations: French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The screening shadow only logs; job-page quarantine still comes from the rules. Live speech and the career interview still need DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude key on staging. The local-first desktop has no career interview.
